rationale.consistency: Module registration, Caddyfile parsing, license headers, zap Check-logging and standard/imports all follow sibling handlers; handler uses time.Duration like requestbody rather than caddy.Duration.
rationale.edge_cases: Hard-deadline cap, nil body, zero/negative values, unsupported controller and chunk boundaries are handled; but per-route subdirective is named max_write_chunk instead of the required write_max_chunk, and rate credit multiplies transferred*1e9 which overflows past ~9 GB.
rationale.scope: Deletes request_body's read_timeout/write_timeout options and Provision, a breaking change to existing configs that the requirement neither asked for nor permits; server Caddyfile options also grow an unrequested rate argument.
rationale.readability: Structure is clear and names are descriptive; comments are thorough though somewhat editorial (nginx/Apache comparisons) and long.
rationale.robustness: Deadline errors are handled once and disable further attempts; no panics on bad input; overflow in the MinRate credit computation can kill large legitimate transfers; per-route wrapper ignores server hard deadlines.
rationale.maintainability: Single shared IdleDeadline/reader/writer reused by server and handler avoids duplication; exported struct fields widen the public API surface but keep coupling explicit.
